reviewItem.question: Does "ACME E2E Tests: Upgraded Pebble to `v2.7.0` and modified the ACME tests to match latest Pebble behavior" mean a change to product-relationship:cert-manager|name=pebble (requirement-changed)?

proposed.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 upgraded Pebble, the ACME test server used by its own end-to-end tests, to v2.7.0 and adjusted those tests to match the latest Pebble behavior; the change is confined to the test suite and has no operational consequence for cert-manager deployments.
